# Hash-locked transitive closure of the `awscurl` CLI used by
# .github/workflows/theorycloud-facetheory-subtree-publish.yml.
#
# Install with:
#   python3 -m pip install --user --require-hashes --no-deps \
#     --requirement .github/requirements/theorycloud-publish-awscurl.txt
#
# Every requirement is pinned to an exact version and every installable
# artifact (wheel and sdist) is hash-pinned, so pip can only install reviewed
# bytes and can never resolve mutable PyPI code. Regenerate deliberately when
# awscurl or one of its dependencies must move; never loosen this to a range.
